ycoss:12072.long_description: CareerTu is an online school for today’s most in-demand digital skills, starting with digital marketing, data analytics, and product design. We teach our students real-world business problems via capstone projects to make sure they are equipped with the must-have technical skills. 250+ top companies hired CareerTu students in 14 countries - including Google, Facebook, Microsoft, Amazon, Spotify, Pinterest, LVMH, TikTok, Expedia, Alibaba, Tencent, Meituan etc. CareerTu's mission is to teach students the industry’s most relevant and in-demand skills, making them the ideal hire at their dream companies, in return providing businesses with experienced and reliable talents to increase their efficiency. 华语数字化技能学习平台。通过系统学习高薪数字化技能, 迅速培养新兴行业紧缺的人，为全球14个国家的科技和新零售企业, 不断输送优秀人才。
ycoss:12072.metadata_document: CareerTu is a Y Combinator company. It participated in the Winter 2019 batch, in 2019. Its status is inactive. Its stage is early. Y Combinator lists its industry as Education. Y Combinator source tags: Education, Careers. It is located in New York City, NY, USA; New York, NY, USA. Listed regions: United States of America, America / Canada, Remote, Partly Remote. Its team size is 15. It launched in 2018.
